def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if value is None:

    if isinstance(value, bool):

    if isinstance(value, str):

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Mapping, Optional

import requests


OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ThresholdDecision:
    allow: bool
    flagged: bool
    triggered_categories: Dict[str, float]
    category_scores: Dict[str, float]
    raw: Dict[str, Any]


def _resolve_api_key(api_key: Optional[str]) -> str:
    token = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not token:
        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
    return token


def _openai_moderate(text: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model: str = OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    response = requests.post(
        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {_resolve_api_key(api_key)}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        json={"model": model, "input": text},
        timeout=30,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()


def _extract_result(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    results = payload.get("results") or []
    return results[0] if results else {}


def _normalize_thresholds(thresholds: Optional[Mapping[str, float]]) -> Dict[str, float]:
    if not thresholds:
        return {}
    return {str(category): float(value) for category, value in thresholds.items()}


def apply_category_thresholds(
    text: str,
    thresholds: Optional[Mapping[str, float]] = None,
    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
    model: str = OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL,
) -> ThresholdDecision:
    payload = _openai_moderate(text, api_key=api_key, model=model)
    result = _extract_result(payload)
    categories = {str(k): bool(v) for k, v in (result.get("categories") or {}).items()}
    scores = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in (result.get("category_scores") or {}).items()}
    normalized_thresholds = _normalize_thresholds(thresholds)

    triggered: Dict[str, float] = {}
    for category, threshold in normalized_thresholds.items():
        score = scores.get(category, 0.0)
        if score >= threshold:
            triggered[category] = score

    flagged = bool(result.get("flagged", False)) or any(categories.values()) or bool(triggered)
    allow = not flagged
    return ThresholdDecision(
        allow=allow,
        flagged=flagged,
        triggered_categories=triggered,
        category_scores=scores,
        raw=payload,
    )


def safety_threshold(text: str, thresholds: Optional[Mapping[str, float]] = None) -> bool:
    return apply_category_thresholds(text, thresholds=thresholds).allow


def safety_threshold_from_env(text: str) -> bool:
    return safety_threshold(text)","lineStart":1,"lineEnd":89,"totalLines":89,"truncated":false}},"title":"private/var/folders/bf/pt_kfhl16yb4r9vfb588n1fm0000gn/T/vb-staged-nxfj0kqc/safety_threshold.py","time":{"start":1789862336580,"end":1789862336583}},"metadata":{"openai":{"itemId":"fc_0f1d9d5888a6b62c016aaf21c074b087d2a809b020984a49c5"}},"id":"prt_0bc1bd835001P61Emo30eCttit","sessionID":"ses_f43e4368cffe5VQ2OEqNssQNCU","messageID":"msg_0bc1bd00c001zzVYVFXJp5OafO"}}

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_CHAT_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL = "gpt-4.1-mini"
+
+
+def _resolve_api_key(api_key: Optional[str]) -> str:
+    token = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not token:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return token
+
+
+def _coerce_decision_text(decision: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    if "summary" in decision and decision["summary"] is not None:
+        return str(decision["summary"])
+    if "decision" in decision and decision["decision"] is not None:
+        return str(decision["decision"])
+    if decision.get("flagged") is True:
+        return "flagged"
+    if decision.get("flagged") is False:
+        return "allowed"
+    return "unknown"
+
+
+def _render_input(decisions: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
+    lines: List[str] = []
+    for index, decision in enumerate(decisions, start=1):
+        message = str(decision.get("message", ""))
+        label = _coerce_decision_text(decision)
+        categories = decision.get("categories") or {}
+        scores = decision.get("category_scores") or {}
+        triggered = decision.get("triggered_categories") or {}
+        lines.append(f"Item {index}:")
+        lines.append(f"Message: {message}")
+        lines.append(f"Decision: {label}")
+        if categories:
+            lines.append(f"Categories: {categories}")
+        if scores:
+            lines.append(f"Category scores: {scores}")
+        if triggered:
+            lines.append(f"Triggered thresholds: {triggered}")
+        reason = decision.get("reason") or decision.get("rationale")
+        if reason:
+            lines.append(f"Reason: {reason}")
+        lines.append("")
+    return "\n".join(lines).strip()
+
+
+def summarize_moderation_decisions(
+    decisions: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]],
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
+    model: str = OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    token = _resolve_api_key(api_key)
+    prompt = _render_input(decisions)
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_CHAT_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": model,
+            "messages": [
+                {"role": "system", "content": "Summarize moderation decisions concisely for a policy reviewer."},
+                {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
+            ],
+            "temperature": 0,
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    choices = payload.get("choices") or []
+    summary = ""
+    if choices:
+        message = choices[0].get("message") or {}
+        summary = str(message.get("content") or "")
+    return {"model": model, "summary": summary, "raw": payload}
+
+
+def summarize_moderation_decisions_from_env(decisions: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return summarize_moderation_decisions(decisions)
